name: lot_developer_update_lot_elements_kind
description: Test 27 (§6.4, §16), the corrected terrain-change kind. Slot 37 UpdateLotElements takes the BDS's WHOLE 32-bit terrain-change kind, not a bool; its only use is the full 32-bit compare kind != 5 (building-development.md 4.11). A lot in state 3 without a foundation (flags & 3 = 0), with a configuration whose maximum slope before foundation (0.0) is below the lot slope (4.0 from a peak at vertex (1,0)): kind 5 -> the foundation branch is skipped entirely, so no AddLotFoundation and UpdateLotBaseTextureOccupant gets had_foundation false; kind 0x105 -> one AddLotFoundation and had_foundation true; kind 0x100 (low byte 0, so kind & 0xFF != 0 would wrongly be false) -> also one AddLotFoundation, proving the compare is on the whole value and not the low byte. UpdateLotElements always returns true. A lot in state below 2 does nothing. A lot WITH a foundation updates the foundation and retaining walls instead. The foundation itself is built per §17.5.4 (slot 54 -> R8 -> slot 55 -> BDS slot 23): the lot faces 0, so its top is the middle of corners 0 and 1 (100 and 104) = 102, below the highest vertex 104, so the retaining walls are added. The lot gets flags 3, which are cleared again before each re-check.

steps.note: vertex index 1 = (x=1, z=0): the lot slope is 4.0
maximum slope before foundation 0.0 is below the lot slope 4.0
kind 5: the foundation re-check is skipped
no AddLotFoundation; UpdateLotBaseTextureOccupant gets had_foundation false; UpdateSlope runs
kind 0x105 != 5: one AddLotFoundation (R8 over the one foundation ID); the slope 4.0 > 0.25 also runs UpdateLotObjectAlitudes; had_foundation true
clear the foundation flags so the next call re-checks
kind 0x100 (low byte 0) != 5 as a whole value: still one AddLotFoundation. This is the case a kind & 0xFF != 0 reduction would get wrong.
state below 2: nothing happens at all

a lot WITH a foundation (flags & 3 != 0): UpdateLotFoundation and UpdateLotRetainingWalls instead, no slope work. Lot 3 has the flag but no foundation occupant on its cell, so slot 61 goes through slot 54 (R8) and slot 55 with the lot's altitude (0) as the top: no levelling, no walls; the bottom is the lowest vertex, 100, so the depth is raised to 0.5
